title: Freeze Student V0.1 activity-richness successor architecture
purpose: Freeze the smallest explicit successor contract and parallel execution program needed to produce a richer learner-facing Student V0.1 without mutating v2/v3, without treating RC718 as a migration base, and without introducing a generic activity/plugin runtime.
invariants: learnit.kit.v2 and learnit.kit.v3 meanings remain unchanged.
lesson and flashcard are non-scored in Student V0.1 and never constitute validation/mastery evidence.
Correct answers, matching solutions, correct order, classify assignments and acceptedResponses never cross learner-safe ActivityPresentation.
UI owns interaction mechanics, not correctness.
No dynamic plugin loader, evaluator registry, event bus, backend, accounts, cloud catalog or remote AI scoring is introduced.
RC718 is historical evidence only and is not a migration or compatibility base.
Wave 1 may begin only after human acceptance and merge of this architecture package.
requiredEvidence: v4 JSON Schema is valid Draft 2020-12.
v2 and v3 schemas are unchanged by the architecture PR.
Every admitted activity family has explicit authored, presentation, response and evaluation/completion semantics.
Media is embedded/local and carries alt text plus pedagogical role.
Wave 1 roles have disjoint writable responsibilities and integration-only files remain integrator-owned.
Repository governance and PR scope pass or are explicitly pending exact-head CI.
adversarialTests: Any product/runtime/authoring/workflow implementation fails architecture scope.
Any edit to v2 or v3 schema fails scope.
Any scoring secret in learner-safe presentation fails architecture review.
Any lesson/flashcard correctness/mastery claim fails semantics review.
Any multi-label classify behavior fails first-slice scope.
Any remote media dependency fails first-slice scope.
Any generic plugin/evaluator runtime fails anti-complexity review.
Any overlapping Wave 1 writable path without an explicit preparatory seam blocks parallel execution.
nonGoals: Implement learner/runtime code in this architecture work package.
Modify Authoring Studio or AI Kit Factory implementation in this architecture work package.
Change the learnit.kit.v2 or learnit.kit.v3 schema or published meaning.
Merge, cherry-pick or supersede PR #376 as part of this architecture work package.
Define LLM, rubric or semantic scoring for constructed responses.
Reintroduce RC718 migration, compatibility or shared learner-state behavior.
Build a generic plugin loader, evaluator registry, event bus or marketplace architecture.
Introduce backend, accounts, synchronization, cloud catalog or remote media dependencies.
Start Wave 1 implementation before the G0 human architecture gate.
independentReview: Silently expanding learnit.kit.v3 is rejected because an already-published discriminator must not change meaning according to reader age.
An out-of-band plugin or capability payload is rejected because it would split canonical learning semantics across authorities instead of keeping one explicit kit contract.
lesson is separate from flashcard because exposition/completion and active-recall/reveal are different learner interactions and neither should be disguised as scored evidence.
classify is admitted as a new family because assigning many items to named buckets is not cleanly represented by one-to-one matching without distorting the learner interaction.
The presenter abstraction is deliberately limited to a typed internal seam; a dynamic plugin framework remains unjustified.
Embedded-only media is selected for the first student slice to preserve deterministic offline behavior and bounded security; remote media is deferred.
This v4 package is architecture evidence only: Wave 1 remains blocked until explicit human acceptance and exact-head repository/scope qualification.
rollback: Close the draft architecture PR and delete its branch. Main, v2, v3, learner runtime, authoring stack and learner data remain unchanged.
